S03-prompt.description: Use image1 hand and natural tripod grip, but make the pencil a black wooden GRAPHITE pencil. Remove the small blue patch so absolutely no color remains on paper. The overall artwork is only very faint preliminary graphite construction lines in the exact same source layout. The same hand moves as one unit slightly down to touch one existing upper-right wing feather contour; retain exact hand anatomy, grip, nail shape, supported wrist. At its tip a single short clean thin graphite feather-outline segment is darker, the rest of drawing is faint guides on white paper. No filled shading, no finished black feathers, no loose new line disconnected from the design. Camera closer as specified without rotating the portrait sheet. Keep the main crane axis vertically aligned with KOREA below exactly as image2. Only one right hand. Drawing upright to artist sitting below the frame.

S04-base-prompt.task: Progress-stage edit of image1; image2 exact design master
S04-base-prompt.description: Keep image1 absolutely identical in camera, hand, skin, pencil, page position and all contour geometry. Change ONLY the progress of the artwork to the FIRST BLUE COLOR stage. ALL artwork is an uncolored precise thin graphite outline, including the sun, mountain, feathers, both cranes, horizontal ornaments and KOREA. Remove orange, yellow, green, red, black filled shading and all blue except one SMALL lightly shaded blue patch directly underneath the exact blue pencil tip in the existing blue-water region. The small blue patch covers less than five percent of the artwork. The rest stays white paper inside fine gray contours. The larger crescent left of the main crane neck stays white as in image2.
S04-base-prompt.continuity: Exact same right hand anatomy, nail shape, relaxed tripod grip, pencil angle, supported wrist and pale blue sleeve from image1. Preserve same contact location and keep ink/pigment inside actual original contour. Paper portrait upright, flat horizontal desk, top toward frame top, KOREA horizontal below large crane, small crane below text.
S04-base-prompt.camera: Same zero-roll perpendicular top-down photograph, entire portrait sheet centered in 16:9 frame. No sideways paper, no oblique perspective.
S04-base-prompt.lighting: Constant soft neutral daylight same direction and exposure.
S04-base-prompt.materials: Realistic skin with subtle pores/creases and no new noise, matte ivory desk, fine white paper, faint dry graphite outlines, genuine dry blue pencil pigment. No liquids or brushes.
S04-base-prompt.text: Exact KOREA outline position/size from reference; no new lettering.

S05-prompt.description: Photorealistic 16:9 overhead working photograph. Keep the exact upright portrait sheet from image1 centered on the same smooth ivory table, top edge at top of frame, KOREA word horizontal and readable below the large crane, small crane below that. All other elements match image1 precisely.
